svg.title: Clean knowledge graph generation pipeline
svg.desc: Enabled connector records are read into a disposable build. Token-aware passages are embedded. GLiNER2 extracts source-global entities and directed temporal relations in bounded batches. Entities resolve conservatively, facts retain passage and note provenance, a passage entity fact base graph is constructed, and a degree-capped note projection is derived only for visualization. Invariants and hashes must pass before atomic activation.
svg.text: Enabled connectors → disposable build → atomic activation
Clean source snapshot
sorted connector records · deterministic source hash
Token-aware source passages
stable offsets/IDs · overlap · title/source context
Qwen3 passage embeddings + SQLite FTS5
Batched GLiNER2 extraction
source-family schemas · token-budgeted short batches
global offsets for long documents · isolated note failures
DeBERTa is the GLiNER2 encoder, not a second extraction pass
Conservative entity + fact materialization
case/type/digit guards · ambiguity preserved · hubs flagged
directed predicates · temporal validity · passage/note provenance
failed extraction never reuses stale entities or facts
Uncapped retrieval base graph
passage semantic kNN · passage↔entity contains edges
directed logical fact edges · independent-note noisy-or support
one logical relation connectivity contribution; all fact IDs retained
Derived note projection
deterministic forest + degree cap · visualization only
Validation and build report
counts · failures · hubs · components · dangling nodes · timings
model/config/calibration hashes · deterministic graph hash
Atomic replace + immutable snapshot
